simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אָכַל (H398) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 815 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אָכַל (ʼâkal) means to eat (literally or figuratively) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 12 40.

definitions.usage: × at all, burn up, consume, devour(-er, up), dine, eat(-er, up), feed (with), food, × freely, × in...wise(-deed, plenty), (lay) meat, × quite.

Niph`al Perfect וְנֶאֱבַל consecutive Exod 22:5 Imperfect יֵאָכֵל Gen 6:21 +; וַיֵּאָכֵ֫ל Num 12:12 , etc.; Infinitive absolute הֵאָבֹל Lev 7:18 ; 19:7 ; Participle feminine נֶאֱכֶ֫לֶת 11:47 ; — 1 be eaten by man Exod 12:46 ; 13:3 , 7 ; 21:28 ; 29:34 ; Lev 6:9 ; 6:16 ; 6:19 ; 6:23 ; 7:6 , 15 , 16 (twice in verse); 7:18 ; 11:41 ; 19:6 ; 19:7 ; 19:23 ; 22:30 ; Lev 28:17; Ezek 45:21 ; of custom, usage Gen 6:21 ; Exod 12:16 ; Deut 12:22 ; Job 6:6 ; of permission to eat Lev 7:19 ; 11:13 , 34 , 47 (twice in verse); 17:13 ; with negative be uneatable Jer 24:2-3 , 8 ; 29:17 . 2 be devoured by fire, consumed Zeph 1:18 ; 3:8 ; Zech 9:4 ; Ezek 23:25 . 3 be wasted, destroyed , of flesh Num 12:12 ; Jer 30:16 . Pu`al Perfect אֻכְּלוּ be consumed with fire Neh 2:3 , 13 compare Nahum 1:10 (figurative); so Participle אֻכָּל (= מְאֻכָּל Ew § 169 d ) Exod 3:2 ; by sword Isa 1:20 תְּאֻכְּלוּ . Hiph`il Perfect 2masculine singular suffix הֶאֱכַלְתָּם Psa 80:6 , וְהַאֲכַלְתִּ֫י Isa 49:26 ; suffix וְהַאֲכַלְתִּיךָ consecutive 58:14 ; הֶאֱכַלְתִּיח Ezek 16:19 ; וְהַאֲכַלְתִּים consecutive Jer 19:9 ; Imperfect suffix יַאֲכִלֵנוּ Num 11:4 , 18 , etc.; 2masculine singular js. תַּאֲכֵל ; 1 singular אוֺכִיל Hosea 11:4 ; Imperative הַאֲכִילֵהוּ Prov 25:21 , etc.; Infinitive לְהָכִיל Ezekiel 21:33 (but Co לההל , q. v.); Participle מַאֲבִיל Jer 23:15 , etc.; — 1 cause to eat, feed with , followed by 2 accusative subject mostly ׳י ; Exod 16:32 ; Deut 8:3 , 16 ; Ezek 3:2 ; Jer 19:9 ; absolute Hosea 11:4 ; compare Num 11:4 , 18 ; figurative Jer 9:14 ; 23:15 ; Isa 49:26 ; 58:14 ; Ezek 16:19 ; also Psa 80:6 דִּמְעָ֑ה לֶחֶם הֶאֱבַלְתָּם (compare 102:10 Qal above); followed by accusative of person + מן Psalm 81:17, but also subject man Prov 25:21 ; 1Kin 22:27 ; 2Chr 18:26 לַ֫חַץ לֶחֶם וְהַאֲכִלֻהוּ of prison fare; followed by accusative of person only 28:15 , compare Ezek 2:3 . 2 cause to devour , object sword Ezekiel 21:33 (but on text see Co). [ אֲכַל ] verb eat, devour (Biblical Hebrew); — Pe`al Perfect 3masculine plural אֲכַ֫לוּ Dan 3:8 ; 6:25 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular יֵאכֻל 4:30 ; 3 feminine singular תֵּאכֻל 7:23 ; Imperative feminine singular אֲכֻּ֫לִי 7:5 ; Participle feminine singular אָֽכְלָה , 7:7 ; 7:9 ; — 1 eat , of beast, Dan 4:30 (accusative of thing). 2 devour , of beast in vision, Dan 7:5 (accusative of thing), absolute 7:7 ; 7:19 ; hence figurative of kingdom, devour, devastate , 7:23 (accusative of earth). 3 in phrase ׳א ק־רְצֵיהוֺן Dan 3:8 eat their pieces , i.e. slander them, compare 6:25 (see קְרַץ ).
